		#Mostly covered by Depression recovery and low debt. Adding 1938 recession
		command = { trigger = { country = USA year = 1938 NOT = { year = 1939 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = -15 }
		
		#France historic growth rates 1935-1939: -3% 4% 6% 0% 7%
		#Mostly covered by high sovereign debt, adding exceptionally good 1937/1939 and bad 1938 (probably fallout from US recession)
		command = { trigger = { country = VIC year = 1937 NOT = { year = 1938 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = 3   }
		command = { trigger = { country = VIC year = 1938 NOT = { year = 1939 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = -3  }

		#UK historic growth rates 1935-1939: 4% 5% 3% 1% 1%
		#Covered by high sovereign debt
		
		#Japan historic growth rates 1935-1939: 4% 6% 4% 5% 14%
		#Depression recovery (+4) and developing country boost (+1) offset by high WAR (-4.8) and high MIL (-1) from early on
		#adding exceptionally good 1939
		command = { trigger = { country = JAP year = 1939 NOT = { year = 1940 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = 8   }
		
		#India under colonial rule did not grow very fast in general
		command = { trigger = { OR = { country = U02 puppet = { country = -1 country = U02 } } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = -3 }
		#famine 1943

		command = { trigger = { country = IND year = 1943 NOT = { year = 1944 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = -10 }
		command = { trigger = { country = PAK year = 1943 NOT = { year = 1944 } } type = industrial_modifier which = ic  value = -10 }

	}

				OR = {
					war = { country = CHC }
					war = { country = U58 }
				}
				NOT = {
					war = { country = CHI }
					war = { country = USA }
					war = { country = ENG }
					war = { country = SOV }
					war = { country = VIC }
				}
			}
		}
		local_flag = AllInit
	}

	desc = EVT_3120_DESC
	style = 2
	picture = "Wehrmacht"

	offset = 15
	deathdate = { day = 29 month = december year = 1948 }

		name = "ACTION_NAME_OK"
		command = { type = local_setflag which = warDuration }
		command = { type = event which = 3121 where = -1 when = 360 }
	}

#problem with this: if an automatic change happens afterwards before the change policy timer expires (60 days), it will still be counted as another manual change.
#another problem: a player can get one change in for free at the start of the game without suffering consequences unless the "ideology" flag in the scenario file
event = { #Manual policy change check
	id = 3125
	random = no
	persistent = yes
	
	trigger = {	
		ai = no #AI will never change manually
		local_flag = AllInit
		NOT = { can_change_policy = { type = political_left value = 1 } } #changed policy manually
		OR = {
			AND = {
				policy = { type = political_left value = 1 }
				NOT = { policy = { type = political_left value = 2 } }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = ideology when = 0 value = 1 } }
			}
			AND = {
				policy = { type = political_left value = 2 }
				NOT = { policy = { type = political_left value = 3 } }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = ideology when = 0 value = 2 } }
			}
			AND = {
				policy = { type = political_left value = 3 }
				NOT = { policy = { type = political_left value = 4 } }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = ideology when = 0 value = 3 } }
			}
			AND = {
				policy = { type = political_left value = 4 }
				NOT = { policy = { type = political_left value = 5 } }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = ideology when = 0 value = 4 } }
			}

				policy = { type = political_left value = 5 }
				NOT = { policy = { type = political_left value = 6 } }

	}

	offset = 10
	deathdate = { day = 29 month = december year = 1948 }

#Belligerence maluses. The idea is, countries with very high belligerence, regardless of whether they are targeted by formal sanctions, will likely lose out on preferential trade opportunities AND lose out on the ability to profit from the wars of other nations. Also high belligerence likely means large occupied territory, which itself requires maintenance.

event = { 
	id = 3150
	random = no
	persistent = yes
	#invisible
	
	trigger = {	
		local_flag = AllInit
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { belligerence = { value = 20 	} }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = belligerence when = 0 value = 0	 	} }
			}
			AND = {
				belligerence 		 = { value = 20 	}
				NOT = { belligerence = { value = 40 	} }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = belligerence when = 0 value = 20 	} }
			}
			AND = {
				belligerence 		 = { value = 40 	}
				NOT = { belligerence = { value = 60 	} }
				NOT = { local_flag = { which = belligerence when = 0 value = 40 	} }
			}
			AND = {
				belligerence 		 = { value = 60 	}
				NOT = { belligerence = { value = 80 	} }
